data.statement: Replace Speech Blocks narrator-and-character generation with an operator-review direct LLM block-splitting contract that preserves source text where aligned, flags uncertain output for review, uses segment-level fallback instead of whole-chunk atomic fallback, and remains interruptible and resumable.

acceptance: Speech Blocks can generate reviewable narrator-and-character blocks from direct LLM text responses, preserves aligned source slices, flags gaps/unmatched/unknown output for operator review, falls back only failed segments, splits large dialogue-heavy chunks before model output becomes too large, resumes after completed segments, and no longer emits a whole-chunk narrator fallback for chunk-0033-style failures.
assumptions: Use the recommended source policy: preserve original source text where aligned and mark uncertainty for review rather than trusting unmatched LLM text.
Use the recommended failure policy: save deterministic narrator review fallback for only the failed segment and continue.
No compatibility migration is required for old atomic/source-span operation state or old repair responses.
open_questions: Approve medium-risk breaking replacement of the Speech Blocks narrator-and-character generation contract?
data.reason: Workflow policy requires a human approval pause when risk is medium; this is a breaking replacement of a core generation contract.
recommended_responses: Approve and continue to requirements/checks/implementation using the provided plan.
scope: In scope: prompt/schema replacement, direct block normalization, source-text alignment and review flags, segment-level fallback, output-aware segmentation, segment-level resume/cancel state, relevant tests, requirements, and component documentation. Out of scope: backward compatibility with old atomic/source-span responses or checkpoints, UI redesign beyond existing edit/review surfaces, changing Audio Blocks or Audio Assembly contracts except through existing Speech Blocks outputs, and packaging/release work.
data.understanding: Replace narrator-and-character Speech Blocks generation with an operator-review direct LLM block-splitting contract. The LLM will return ordered blocks containing text, speaker_id, content_kind, confidence, and warning_flags. AudioMancer will preserve source text where returned text can be aligned, mark uncertainty for review, fall back only the failed segment, split large chunks by output-safety limits, and keep generation interruptible/resumable at segment granularity. This is a breaking replacement for the atomic/source-span selection and repair contract; old operation checkpoints do not need migration.

data.summary: Focused direct Speech Blocks tests fail against the old atomic/source-span implementation: unknown speakers lack review flags, source gaps are not inserted, unmatched model text is persisted, direct generation still repairs source-span responses, output-safety segmentation is absent, and segment resume restarts the active chunk.
